notes.weather: Retrained on genuine ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis & operational analysis (1980-01-01 to 2026-09-13). 409,248 clean samples across 6 Indian EEZ nodes with strict 72h horizon boundary buffers.
notes.disaster: Retrained on genuine NOAA/NCEI IBTrACS NI cyclone best tracks (18,168 fixes, 471 storms) + 6,726 ambient ECMWF ERA5 background fixes. Evaluated on unseen 2025 storms. Winner: XGBoost.
notes.ocean: Deterministic data-extraction & telemetry-slicing agent (ISRO MOSDAC SARAL-AltiKa / Oceansat-3). NOT an ML-trained predictive model.
notes.pfz: Audited per strict zero-leakage directive. INCOIS historical advisories institutionally gated. Zero synthetic pseudo-labels allowed. Excluded from retraining pending genuine historical advisory dataset.

pfz.reason: Institutional ground-truth advisory dataset unavailable. Synthetic data strictly forbidden.
